title: feat(contacts): page through the contact list with offset
description: Integrations need to read every contact, not only the first page. Adds an `offset` query parameter to `GET /v1/contacts`, documented in the reference, with its test.
rationale: `offset` reaches `skip()` unchecked: a negative value makes MongoDB reject the query, so the public endpoint answers 500 instead of 400, and `offset=abc` silently reads the first page. A public parameter is validated (a non-negative integer) and refused with 400 otherwise.

extras.note: sort on createdAt alone has no tie-breaker: with skip, tied contacts can be repeated or missed across pages, defeating the stated goal of reading every contact
skip cost grows with an unbounded offset and no index on { accountId, createdAt } is declared: deep pages are a scale risk the PR opens
reading every contact now pays a full account count per page, a cost that did not exist with a single page
newest-first offset paging drifts when contacts are inserted during a full read
the reference does not say that offset pages shift when contacts are created or deleted during paging
the planned defect, anchored elsewhere: the missing validation seen from the reference: no accepted range and no error for an invalid offset
the offset test covers one happy path: no past-the-end page, no tied createdAt, no invalid offset (that last part is the planned defect seen from the test)

keywords: skip comes after the account filter
extras.note: the account filter is the same find() the first test already pins with acc_2 data; skip cannot run outside it
